name: Clamp a number to a range
instruction: Implement clamp(x, lo, hi) in clamp.js: return lo if x < lo, hi if x > hi, otherwise x. Assume lo <= hi. Keep the CommonJS export shape.
verifyCmd: node -e "const f=require('./clamp.js'); if(f(5,0,10)!==5)process.exit(1); if(f(-3,0,10)!==0)process.exit(1); if(f(99,0,10)!==10)process.exit(1); if(f(0,0,10)!==0)process.exit(1); console.log('ok')"
